subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which open repair path should remain canonical for the pathless `read` image media gap: the start-args fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359, the inbound-media persistence approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442, or a replacement that reconciles them?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same source-level gap but make different choices about media provenance and trusted local-media handling, so issue-level automation should not open a third fix or choose between them without maintainer review.

options.title: Review and land one linked repair
options.body: Pick the safer shared repair after PR review, require real behavior proof, and close this issue only after merge.

options.title: Keep both PRs pending for more proof
options.body: Leave this issue open while contributors provide Feishu or cross-channel proof that distinguishes the two approaches.

options.title: Replace both candidates
options.body: Open a maintainer-owned replacement only if both current branches are rejected as unsafe or unmergeable.

recommendation.title: Review and land one linked repair
recommendation.body: Pick the safer shared repair after PR review, require real behavior proof, and close this issue only after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest recent history on the shared embedded-agent media delivery path and current-line ownership after the refactor.
